notes: Adaptive refinement on the L-shaped domain of l_shape_corner: the same corner singularity u = r^(2/3) sin(2 theta / 3), solved on a coarse mesh, then refined where the residual estimator says the error is (Dorfler marking, theta = 0.5, newest vertex bisection) until the estimate is a tenth of the first one or 20000 nodes. The refinement gathers at the re-entrant corner; the Solve step's cycle table and chart show the estimate and, compared with the exact solution in view.exact_solution, the true error against the number of nodes: about N^(-1/2) in the energy norm, the rate of a smooth solution on uniform meshes, where uniform refinement gives only N^(-1/3) here.

geometry.name: l_shape.svg
geometry.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="-1.1 -1.1 2.2 2.2">
  <!-- An L: the square [-1, 1]^2 without the quarter x > 0, y < 0 (SVG's
       y points down; the app flips it, so y < 0 is y > 0 here). The two
       edges at the re-entrant corner (0, 0) are one region. -->
  <path data-region="corner" d="M 0 0 L 1 0" fill="none" stroke="#eb6834" stroke-width="0.02"/>
  <path data-region="outer" d="M 1 0 L 1 -1 L -1 -1 L -1 1 L 0 1" fill="none" stroke="#2a78d6" stroke-width="0.02"/>
  <path data-region="corner" d="M 0 1 L 0 0" fill="none" stroke="#eb6834" stroke-width="0.02"/>
</svg>

outer.g: (x^2 + y^2)^(1/3) * sin(2/3 * Piecewise((atan(y/x), x > 0), (atan(y/x) + pi, x < 0), (pi/2, y > 0), (3*pi/2, True)))

view.exact_solution: (x^2 + y^2)^(1/3) * sin(2/3 * Piecewise((atan(y/x), x > 0), (atan(y/x) + pi, x < 0), (pi/2, y > 0), (3*pi/2, True)))
